contact_audit.method: Exact Python integer predicates on a common power-of-two scaling of stored local float32 coordinates; sweep-and-prune exact bounding boxes, then all six segment-triangle tests including coplanar overlaps. Only contact lying entirely on indexed shared vertices or edges is accepted.
contact_audit.scope: Each stored local preview separately. Does not compare previews against each other or the unchanged global cortex. Does not certify continuous nonlinear images, GPU rounding or anatomical validity.

contact_oracle.method: Independent exact rational plane intersection and Gram-matrix barycentric clipping, with shared-simplex comparison. No Moller-Trumbore or 2D projection predicate reused.

source_contact_comparison_summary.scope: Only the original owner pairs of initially detected preview contacts, not all cortical source faces. Contacts include non-indexed touching as well as crossings; they do not constitute anatomical error diagnoses.
